desc:
🧜‍♀️ Become the most powerful mermaid in the sea! 🧜‍♀️

✨ Tap to grow your Mermaid Power, or relax at a Power Shrine and earn it automatically
⚔️ Swim down the Duel Road and challenge mermaid rivals!
🏰 Win a duel and watch her castle wall burst open to reveal the next challenger
👗 Unlock 17 gorgeous mermaids in the Mermaid Wardrobe, each one stronger than the last
🐬 Adopt pets like the Seahorse, Dolphin and Narwhal to boost your power
🌟 Rebirth to get faster and multiply your power forever
📅 Log in 7 days in a row to unlock a SECRET royal mermaid 👑
🏆 Climb the leaderboards for Power, Wins and Rebirths

🎁 FREE REWARD: Join the Tekipaki Games group, then open the treasure chest in the lobby!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss new mermaids and updates!
